final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(copies) AS avg_copies FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.copies), AVG(rc.copies - ac.avg_copies) FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac WHERE ac.avg_copies IS NOT NULL AND rc.copies > ac.avg_copies
